description: This file defines the DisplayField entity class, which represents a display field in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for id, class name, and related selected display fields, along with getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: DisplayField
classes.description: An Entity class representing display fields within the system, with properties for id, class name, and associated selected display fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the display field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name for the display field.
